tasks.label: prepare-ui-next-cache
args: set -euo pipefail; ui_dir="${workspaceFolder}/UI"; next_dir="${ui_dir}/.next"; if [ ! -d "$next_dir" ]; then exit 0; fi; if find "$next_dir" -not -user "$(id -un)" -print -quit | grep -q .; then echo "Detected non-user-owned .next cache. Removing via docker."; docker run --rm -v "$ui_dir:/app" alpine:3.21 sh -c 'rm -rf /app/.next'; else rm -rf "$next_dir"; fi

tasks.label: prepare-ui-dev-ca
args: set -euo pipefail; pfx_path="${USERPROFILE}/.aspnet/https/WslLocalhost.pfx"; out_dir="/tmp/linewebhook-cert"; out_file="${out_dir}/localhost-dev-root-ca.pem"; if [ ! -f "$pfx_path" ]; then echo "PFX certificate not found: $pfx_path"; exit 1; fi; mkdir -p "$out_dir"; openssl pkcs12 -in "$pfx_path" -nokeys -cacerts -passin pass:WslLocalhost -out "$out_file"
